reviews.text: We had a great experience with Tidal Wave. They definitely know what customer service means. From the start working with Mike designing our pool to JR making sure I found the tile choices I loved. Joey was over seeing the entire process and did great at keeping us informed and updated on all the steps. I really appreciated how clean they kept the construction site along the way and the attention to detail on each step. We love Tidal Wave and I’m certain you will too!
reviews.author: Kayla Lucca

reviews.text:
Tidal Wave Custom Pool Builder

Joey has been absolutely instrumental throughout the entire pool-building process. From the very beginning to now, everything has been smooth sailing. He consistently answered all of our questions and addressed concerns in a timely manner.

Pool building can be stressful—especially when you’re not familiar with the different stages, occasional delays, and what to expect—but Joey took the time to explain each step and kept us well informed throughout. His prompt communication truly made the experience much more enjoyable and stress-free.

They just filled the pool yesterday, and it already looks absolutely beautiful. I would give more than 5 stars if I could. I will definitely be recommending Tidal Wave Custom Pool Builder to my family and friends.
reviews.author: Martial Nguimkeng

reviews.text:
We love our new pool,  Joey was very helpfull throught out the whole process. Answered all of our questions and concerns in a timley manner. We know there was delays due to weather.
We had an issue with the storm drain but they were able to fix it other than that no major issues.
reviews.author: Jose Aguilera

reviews.text:
Wish we could give a negative -1 score.  Multiple issues with the builder.   All work is contracted out and very little support. Constantly missing promises to be onsite for review which resulted in a major repair and then a repair of a repair when they ruptured the newly installed water lines inside of the Gunite pool shell.  The final straw was coping that was not cut according to plan approval and they wanted to charge an additional 10k for "custom" work that was already paid for and approved.  If this cannot be resolved will be going with a different company to finish the project.

And let’s be real.  The “coping situation” you claim was left out wasn’t, evidenced by the signed off images included in the review. The yelling was left out because it never happened Mr Conder, you wouldn’t know because you have never set foot on the property AND I have video proof it never happened.  Let’s also be real about the cuts,  the rendering provided clearly shows random cuts, which we signed off on, we talked about random cuts here and in the showroom, and we have talked at length about the cuts needing to be random in similar style to the existing patio.  In no way shape or form did we agree to straight cuts.  Your statement is patently false.  It was even brought to the attention of your employee before it was laid down, he supposedly stopped work and upon returning it was not corrected and installed anyway.  Any good company would have said, oh ok…wait because there is a question, let’s get it clarified before  doing the work..not afterwards, and then change the story.  Could have been corrected then, but it wasn’t and now it became a bigger problem.  Oh and on the “no rework” is false, your contractor didn’t install the rock footings as required by plan…shooting gunite over gunite is rework…three other pool companies have already confirmed that is the case.  And all payments required  have already been paid.
reviews.author: Anthony Plattsmier

reviews.text:
As first-time pool builders, we had a lot of questions and concerns, but our experience with Tidal Wave Custom Pools was exceptional from start to finish.

After speaking with several pool builders, we immediately felt at ease working with Mike during our first meeting and throughout the pool design process. He listened to our ideas and helped us create a design that we absolutely loved. Mike took the time to work with us and ensure our pool was designed with our vision.  What also stood out to us was the competitive pricing combined with the extensive custom stone upgrades, top of the line pool equipment, and LED lighting included in Tidal Wave’s package.

JR expertly guided us through the detailed construction plans, ensuring that every aspect was thoroughly reviewed and met. During the construction phases, Derek was outstanding, keeping us informed and involved throughout the process. They were always just a phone call away to answer any questions — and I mean any questions. You don’t get this level of service from many other companies.  While we always strive for perfection in construction projects, things don’t always go as planned. That said, JR and Derek were dedicated to addressing any issues that arose, no questions asked, ensuring we were happy and satisfied with the results.

We made several changes to our initial pool design along the way. The flexibility they offered was remarkable. JR and Derek were always accommodating, making sure our vision came to life in the final pool build product.

I can't recommend Tidal Wave Custom Pools enough. In fact, I have already recommended them to several friends.  They made the entire process enjoyable and delivered a beautiful custom pool that has far exceeded our expectations which our family will enjoy for years to come.
reviews.author: Noe Nava

reviews.text:
I LOVE MY POOL!! Tidal Wave Custom Pools made our dream of a backyard oasis come true! They took our ideas and made them even better. JR designed & brought to life a beautiful and functional space for all of our family & friends to enjoy.

JR, the owner & Derek, the project manager are a magnificent duo! They were both so great to work with throughout this whole process. They're both super knowledgeable at every stage and bring a level of expertise that I was very impressed with. I loved being able to ask them all the questions. They were available anytime a call or text was made, day or night or weekend.

Once the day came to turn on the pool, Derek showed up bright and early to get everything going. He is like the pool equipment guru. He literally knows EVERYTHING! I'm so glad we picked these guys to work with. I will refer them every chance I get.
reviews.author: Leah Franks

reviews.text: From the very first meeting until construction was complete, the folks at Tidal Wave were a pleasure to work with. The designer, Mike, captured our ideas and did a great job bringing them to life. JR and Derek were there every step of the way. Our questions were always answered timely, consistently putting our minds at ease. We were never left in the dark during the process leaving us feeling confident in our choice to select Tidal Wave to build our pool. The end result was a beautiful pool and Tidal Wave exceeded our expectations. We are so thankful for all the folks at Tidal Wave and we highly recommend them if you are considering building a pool.
reviews.author: Steven Matte

reviews.text: We had the best experience dealing with Tidal waves... JR and his project manager Derek are so easy to work with. Right from the design stage to completion it was smooth sailing. Shout out to Mike for being patient and very detailed about the process and expectations and introduced us to JR, who turned out to be the best professional we've talked to in this industry. He just didn't deliver 100% but went an extra mile to make sure we got what we wanted. It's a 5 star to Tidal waves and to the whole team.
reviews.author: Pankaj Pathania

data.summary: Reviews appear largely authentic with a strong positive trend, but the company is young (founded 2023). The single detailed negative review raises credible concerns about project management, subcontractor oversight, and post-completion support. The volume and detail of positive reviews suggest generally good work, but potential issues with consistency and accountability exist.
fake_signals: Multiple 5-star reviews posted within a short timeframe (a month ago)
Similar naming of staff (Mike, JR, Joey, Derek) across many reviews

negative_evidence: Major repair needed due to ruptured water lines, followed by a 'repair of a repair'

authentic_signals: Specific project details (storm drain issue, tile choices, gunite shell rupture)
Mix of praise and specific negative feedback in complaints
data.discrepancy_explanation: Google and BBB ratings are high and consistent. Angi rating of 4.2 is slightly lower but not a major discrepancy given different user bases. No Yelp or Glassdoor data to compare.
